paper.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.venue: 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022)

problem_tree.node: Root: Improving reasoning abilities of large language models through chain-of-thought prompting
problem_tree.description: This paper investigates how chain-of-thought prompting can enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models across various reasoning tasks.
problem_tree.evidence: Abstract and Introduction sections of the paper.

children.node: RQ1: How does chain-of-thought prompting affect performance on arithmetic reasoning tasks?
children.description: This question investigates the impact of chain-of-thought prompting on the performance of language models in solving arithmetic word problems.

children.task: Evaluate performance on the GSM8K benchmark using chain-of-thought prompting.
children.conclusion: Chain-of-thought prompting significantly improves performance on GSM8K.

children.node: RQ2: What is the effect of chain-of-thought prompting on commonsense reasoning tasks?
children.description: This question explores how chain-of-thought prompting influences the performance of language models on commonsense reasoning tasks.

children.task: Assess performance on the CSQA and StrategyQA benchmarks using chain-of-thought prompting.
children.conclusion: Chain-of-thought prompting improves performance on commonsense reasoning tasks.

children.node: RQ3: How does chain-of-thought prompting facilitate symbolic reasoning?
children.description: This question investigates the role of chain-of-thought prompting in enhancing symbolic reasoning capabilities of language models.

children.task: Evaluate performance on symbolic reasoning tasks such as last letter concatenation and coin flip.
children.conclusion: Chain-of-thought prompting enables better performance in symbolic reasoning tasks.
